The persistent haze over many of our cities is a reminder of the polluted air that we breathe. Over 80% of the world's urban population is breathing air that fails to meet World Health Organisation guidelines, and an estimated 4.5 million people died 26 from outdoor air pollution in 2015.

Globally, urban populations are expected to double in the next 40 years, and an extra 2 billion people will need new places to live, as well as services and ways to move around their cities. What is more important, the decisions that we make now about the design of our cities will 27 the everyday lives and health of the corning generations. So what would a smog-free, or at least low­ pollution, city be like?

Traffic has become 28 with air pollution, and many countries intend to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel cars in the next two decades. But simply 29 to electric cars will not mean pollution-free cities. The level of emissions they cause will depend on how the electricity to run them is 30 , while brakes, tyres and roads all create tiny airborne 3 1 as they wear out.

Across the developed world, car use is in decline as more people move to city centers, while young people especially are 32 for other means of travel. Researchers are already asking if motor vehicle use has reached its 33 and will decline, but transport planners have yet to catch up with this 34 , instead of laying new roads to tackle traffic jams. As users of London's orbital M25 motorway will know, new roads rapidly fill with more traffic. In the US, studies have shown that doubling the size of a road can 35 double the traffic, taking us back to the starting point.

paragraphs.sourceText: How Much Protein Do You Really Need?
paragraphs.translationZh: 您真正需要多少蛋白质？

paragraphs.sourceText: A) The marketing is tempting: Get stronger muscles and healthier bodies with minimal effort by adding protein powder to your morning shake or juice drink. Or grab a protein bar at lunch or for a quick snack. Today, you can find protein supplements everywhere - online or at the pharmacy, grocery store or health food store. They come in powders, pills and bars. With more than $ 12 billion in sales this year, the industry is booming and, according to the market research company, Grand View Research, is on track to sell billions more by 2025. But do we really need all this supplemental protein? It depends. There are pros, cons and some other things to consider.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 营销很诱人：通过在早晨奶昔或果汁饮料中添加蛋白粉，以最小的努力获得更强的肌肉和更健康的身体。或者在午餐或快餐时吃一块蛋白质棒。如今，您随处都可以找到蛋白质补充剂 - 网上、药房、杂货店或保健食品店。它们有粉末、丸剂和棒状形式。该行业今年的销售额超过 120 亿美元，正在蓬勃发展，根据市场研究公司 Grand View Research 的数据，到 2025 年，该行业的销售额有望增加数十亿美元。但我们真的需要所有这些补充蛋白质吗？这取决于。有优点、缺点和其他一些需要考虑的事情。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) For starters, protein is critical for every cell in our body. It helps build nails, hair, bones and muscles. It can also help you feel fuller longer than eating foods without protein. And, unlike nutrients that are found only in a few foods, protein is present in all foods. " The typical American diet is a lot higher in protein than a lot of us think," says registered dietitian Angela Pipitone. " It's in foods many of us expect, such as beef, chicken and other types of meat and dairy. But it's also in foods that may not come immediately to mind like vegetables, fruit, beans and grains."
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 首先，蛋白质对于我们体内的每个细胞都至关重要。它有助于塑造指甲、头发、骨骼和肌肉。与吃不含蛋白质的食物相比，它还可以帮助您更长时间地感到饱腹感。而且，与仅在少数食物中含有的营养素不同，蛋白质存在于所有食物中。 “典型的美国饮食中的蛋白质含量比我们许多人想象的要高得多，”注册营养师安吉拉·皮皮托内说。 “它存在于我们许多人期望的食物中，例如牛肉、鸡肉以及其他类型的肉类和奶制品。但它也存在于我们可能不会立即想到的食物中，例如蔬菜、水果、豆类和谷物。”

paragraphs.sourceText: C) The U.S. government's recommended daily allowance (RDA) for the average adult is 50 to 60 grams of protein a day. This may sound like a lot, but Pipitone says: " We get bits of protein here and there and that really adds up throughout the day." Take, for example, breakfast. If you eat two eggs topped with a little bit of cheese and an orange on the side, you already have 22 grams of protein. Each egg gives you 7 grams, the cheese gives you about 6 grams and the orange -about 2 grams. Add a lunch of chicken, rice and broccoli (西兰花) , and you are already over the recommended 50 grams. " You can get enough protein and meet the RDA before you even get to dinner," says Pipitone.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 美国政府建议成人平均每日摄入量 (RDA) 为每天 50 至 60 克蛋白质。这听起来可能很多，但皮皮托内说：“我们到处都摄入了一些蛋白质，而且一整天下来这些蛋白质确实会增加。”以早餐为例。如果你吃两个鸡蛋，上面加一点奶酪和一个橙子，你就已经含有 22 克蛋白质。每个鸡蛋含有 7 克，奶酪含有约 6 克，橙子含有约 2 克。午餐加上鸡肉、米饭和西兰花，就已经超过了建议的 50 克。 “你甚至在吃晚饭之前就可以获得足够的蛋白质并达到每日推荐摄入量，”皮皮托内说。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) So if it's so easy to get your protein in food, why add more in the form of powders, snack bars or a boost at your local juice bar? No need to, says Pipitone, because, in fact, most of us already get enough protein in our diet. " Whole foods are always the best option rather than adding supplements," she says, noting the FDA does not regulate supplements as rigorously as foods or drugs. So there could be less protein, more sugar and some additives you wouldn't expect, such as caffeine ������������.
E) If you are considering a supplement, read the list of ingredients, she says, although this is not always reliable. " I've seen very expensive protein supplements that claim to be high quality but
paragraphs.translationZh: E）她说，如果您正在考虑服用补充剂，请阅读成分列表，尽管这并不总是可靠的。 “我见过非常昂贵的蛋白质补充剂，声称是高品质的，但是

paragraphs.sourceText: they might not really be beneficial for the average healthy adult," she says. " It could just be a waste of money."
paragraphs.translationZh: 它们对于普通健康成年人来说可能并不真正有益，”她说。 “这可能只是浪费钱。”

paragraphs.sourceText: F) But there are certain situations that do warrant extra protein. " Anytime you're repairing or building muscle," Pipitone says, such as if you're an extreme endurance athlete, training for a marathon, or you're a body builder. If you're moderately exercising for 1 50 minutes a week, as the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommends, or less than that, you're probably not an extreme athlete. Extreme athletes expend lots of energy breaking down and repairing and building muscles. Protein can give them the edge they need to speed that process.
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 但在某些情况下确实需要额外的蛋白质。 “任何时候你要修复或增强肌肉，”皮皮托内说，比如如果你是一名极限耐力运动员，正在接受马拉松训练，或者你是一名健美运动员。如果您按照疾病控制与预防中心的建议，每周适度锻炼 1 50 分钟，或者少于这个数字，那么您可能不是极限运动员。极限运动员消耗大量能量来分解、修复和增强肌肉。蛋白质可以为他们提供加速这一过程所需的优势。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) Vegans can benefit from protein supplements since they do not eat animal-based protein sources like meat, dairy or eggs. And, for someone always on-the-go who may not have time for a meal, a protein snack bar can be a good option for occasional meal replacement. Also, individuals recovering from surgery or an injury can also benefit from extra protein. So, too, can older people. At around age 60, " muscles really start to break down," says Kathryn Starr, an aging researcher, " and because of that, the protein needs of an older adult actually increase."
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 素食主义者可以从蛋白质补充剂中受益，因为他们不吃肉类、奶制品或鸡蛋等动物性蛋白质来源。而且，对于那些总是忙碌而没有时间吃饭的人来说，蛋白质零食棒可能是偶尔代餐的好选择。此外，从手术或受伤中恢复的人也可以从额外的蛋白质中受益。老年人也可以。衰老研究人员凯瑟琳·斯塔尔 (Kathryn Starr) 表示，在 60 岁左右，“肌肉真正开始分解，因此，老年人对蛋白质的需求实际上增加了。”

paragraphs.sourceText: H) In fact, along with her colleague Connie Bales, Starr recently conducted a small study that found that adding extra protein foods to the diet of obese older individuals who were trying to lose weight strengthened their muscles. Participants in the study were separated into two groups -one group was asked to eat 30 grams of protein per meal in the form of whole foods. That meant they were eating 90 grams of protein a day. The other group - the control group - was put on a typical low-calorie diet with about 50 to 60 grams of protein a day. After six months, researchers found the high protein group had significantly improved their muscle function -almost twice as much as the control group. " They were able to walk faster, had improved balance, and were also able to get up out of a chair faster than the control group," Starr says. All 67 participants were over 60 years of age, and both groups lost about the same amount of weight.
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 事实上，斯塔尔最近与她的同事康妮·贝尔斯 (Connie Bales) 一起进行了一项小型研究，发现在试图减肥的肥胖老年人的饮食中添加额外的蛋白质食物可以增强他们的肌肉。研究参与者被分为两组——一组被要求每餐摄入 30 克天然食品形式的蛋白质。这意味着他们每天吃 90 克蛋白质。另一组（对照组）则采用典型的低热量饮食，每天摄入约 50 至 60 克蛋白质。六个月后，研究人员发现高蛋白组的肌肉功能显着改善，几乎是对照组的两倍。斯塔尔说：“与对照组相比，他们能够走得更快，平衡能力得到改善，并且能够更快地从椅子上站起来。”所有 67 名参与者都超过 60 岁，两组的体重减轻程度大致相同。

paragraphs.sourceText: I) Starr is now looking into whether high-protein diets also improve the quality of the muscle itself in seniors. She's using CT scans to measure muscle size and fat, and comparing seniors on a high­ protein diet to those on regular diets. She says her findings should be available in a couple of months.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 斯塔尔现在正在研究高蛋白饮食是否也能改善老年人的肌肉本身质量。她使用 CT 扫描来测量肌肉大小和脂肪，并将高蛋白饮食的老年人与常规饮食的老年人进行比较。她说她的研究结果应该会在几个月内公布。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) In the meantime, 70-year-old Corliss Keith, who was in the high protein group in Starr's latest study, says she feels a big difference. " I feel excellent," she says. " I feel like I have a different body, I have more energy, I'm stronger." She says she is able to take Zumba exercise classes three times a week, work out on the treadmill �����������, and take long, brisk walks. Keith also lost more than 1 5 pounds. " I'm a fashionable person, so now I'm back in my 3-inch heels," she says.

K) As people age, Starr says muscle strength is key to helping them stay strong and continue living on their own in their own home. " I feel very much alive now," says Keith. " I feel like I could stay by myself until I'm 100."
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 斯塔尔表示，随着人们年龄的增长，肌肉力量是帮助他们保持强壮并继续在自己家里独立生活的关键。 “我现在感觉自己充满活力，”基思说。 “我觉得我可以一个人待到 100 岁。”

paragraphs.sourceText: L) But can people overdo protein? Pipitone says you do have to be careful. Other researchers say too much protein can cause cramps (痉挛) , headaches, and fatigue. Dehydration(脱水) is also a risk when you eat too much protein. Pipitone says if you increase protein, you also have to increase your fluid intake. " I always tell people to make sure they're drinking enough fluids," which for the average person is 60 to 70 ounces a day, which translates into eight 8-ounce glasses of water or liquid per day.
paragraphs.translationZh: L) 但是人们可以过量摄入蛋白质吗？皮皮托内说你必须小心。其他研究人员表示，过多的蛋白质会导致痉挛、头痛和疲劳。当你吃太多蛋白质时，脱水也是一种风险。皮皮托内说，如果你增加蛋白质，你还必须增加液体摄入量。 “我总是告诉人们要确保喝足够的液体”，一般人每天喝 60 到 70 盎司，相当于每天 8 杯 8 盎司的水或液体。

paragraphs.sourceText: M) There have been some indications that extra protein makes the kidneys work harder, which could be problematic for individuals with a history of kidney disease and for them, the supplements may increase the risk of kidney stones, she says.
paragraphs.translationZh: M）有一些迹象表明，额外的蛋白质会使肾脏更加努力地工作，这对于有肾脏疾病史的人来说可能会出现问题，而且对于他们来说，补充剂可能会增加患肾结石的风险，她说。

paragraphs.sourceText: N) Bottom line, if you think you need more protein in your diet, consider these questions: Are you an extreme athlete; are you recovering from injury or surgery; or are you 60 years or older? If so, adding high protein foods like eggs and meat products to your diet can be beneficial. And, if you're not sure, it is always a good idea to check with your primary care provider.
paragraphs.translationZh: N) 最重要的是，如果您认为饮食中需要更多蛋白质，请考虑以下问题：您是极限运动员吗？您正在从受伤或手术中恢复吗？或者您已年满 60 岁吗？如果是这样，在饮食中添加鸡蛋和肉制品等高蛋白食物可能是有益的。而且，如果您不确定，最好咨询您的初级保健提供者。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. It is quite easy for one to take in the recommended amount of protein.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 一个人很容易摄入推荐量的蛋白质。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Pipitone claims that healthy adults need not spend money on protein supplements.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. Pipitone 声称健康成年人不需要花钱购买蛋白质补充剂。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. The protein supplement business is found to be thriving.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 蛋白质补充剂业务正在蓬勃发展。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. Protein can speed the repairing of damaged muscles.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39.蛋白质可以加速受损肌肉的修复。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. Protein supplements may overburden some internal organ, thus leading to its malfunctioning.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 补充蛋白质可能会使某些内脏器官负担过重，从而导致其功能障碍。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41 . Older adults need to take in more protein to keep their muscles strong.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41.老年人需要摄入更多的蛋白质来保持肌肉强壮。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. Protein is found in more foods than people might realize.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 食物中含有的蛋白质比人们想象的要多。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. Additional protein was found to help strengthen the muscles of overweight seniors seeking weight loss.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 研究发现，额外的蛋白质有助于增强寻求减肥的超重老年人的肌肉。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. Pipitone believes that whole foods provide the best source of protein.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. Pipitone 认为天然食品提供了最好的蛋白质来源。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. People are advised to drink more liquid when they take in more protein.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 建议人们在摄入更多蛋白质时多喝液体。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 46 至 50 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Last year, a child was born at a hospital in the UK with her heart outside her body. Few babies survive this rare condition, and those who do must endure numerous operations and are likely to have complex needs. When her mother was interviewed, three weeks after her daughter's birth, she was asked if she was prepared for what might be a daunting ����������������� task caring for her. She answered without hesitation that, as far as she was concerned, this would be a " privilege" .

Rarely has there been a better example of the power of attitude, one of our most powerful psychological tools. Our attitudes allow us to turn mistakes into opportunities, and loss into the chance for new beginnings. An attitude is a settled way of thinking, feeling and/or behaving towards particular objects, people, events or ideologies. We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us. You weren't born with attitudes; rather they are all learned, and this happens in a number of ways.
paragraphs.translationZh: 很少有比这更好的例子来说明态度的力量，态度是我们最强大的心理工具之一。我们的态度使我们能够将错误转化为机会，将损失转化为新开始的机会。态度是对特定物体、人、事件或意识形态的一种固定的思维、感觉和/或行为方式。我们用我们的态度来过滤、解释和反应我们周围的世界。你并不是生来就有态度的，而是有态度的。相反，它们都是经过学习的，而且这可以通过多种方式发生。

paragraphs.sourceText: The most powerful influences occur during early childhood and include both what happened to you directly, and what those around you did and said in your presence. As you acquire a distinctive identity, your attitudes are further refined by the behavior of those with whom you identify-your family, those of your gender and culture, and the people you admire, even though you may not know them personally. Friendships and other important relationships become increasingly important, particularly during adolescence. About that same time and throughout adulthood, the information you receive, especially when ideas are repeated in association with goals and achievements you find attractive, also refines your attitudes.
paragraphs.translationZh: 最强大的影响发生在童年早期，包括直接发生在你身上的事情，以及你周围的人在你面前所做的和所说的。当你获得独特的身份时，你的态度会因那些与你认同的人的行为而进一步完善——你的家人、与你性别和文化相同的人、以及你钦佩的人，即使你个人可能不认识他们。友谊和其他重要的关系变得越来越重要，尤其是在青春期。大约在同一时间，在整个成年期，你收到的信息，尤其是当与你认为有吸引力的目标和成就相关的想法被重复时，也会改善你的态度。

paragraphs.sourceText: Many people assume that our attitudes are internally consistent, that is, the way you think and
paragraphs.translationZh: 许多人认为我们的态度是内在一致的，即你的思考方式和行为方式。

paragraphs.sourceText: feel about someone or something predicts your behavior towards them. However, many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior. In general, your attitudes will be internally consistent only when the behavior is easy, and when those around you hold similar beliefs. That's why, for example, many say they believe in the benefits of recycling or exercise, but don't behave in line with their views, because it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对某人或某事的感觉预示着你对他们的行为。然而，许多研究发现感受和想法并不一定能预测行为。一般来说，只有当行为很容易并且周围的人持有相似的信念时，你的态度才会内部一致。例如，这就是为什么许多人说他们相信回收或锻炼的好处，但行为却与他们的观点不符，因为除了仅仅表明你相信某件事是个好主意之外，还需要意识、努力和勇气。

paragraphs.sourceText: One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to. Take some time to reflect on your attitudes, to think about what you believe and why. Is there anything you consider a burden rather than a privilege? If so, start behaving-right now-as if the latter is the case.
paragraphs.translationZh: 改变态度最有效的方法之一就是开始表现得好像你已经按照你喜欢的方式感觉和思考一样。花一些时间反思一下你的态度，思考一下你相信什么以及为什么。有什么事情你认为是负担而不是特权？如果是这样，那么现在就开始表现得像后者一样。

paragraphs.sourceText: Industrial fishing for krill (磷虾) in the unspoilt waters around Antarctica is threatening the future of one of the world's last great wildernesses, according to a new report.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一份新报告称，在南极洲周围未受破坏的水域中进行磷虾工业捕捞正在威胁着世界上仅存的大片荒野之一的未来。

paragraphs.sourceText: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating " in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale feeding grounds" . It also highlights incidents of fishing boats being involved in groundings, oil spills and accidents, which posed a serious threat to the Antarctic ecosystem.
paragraphs.translationZh: 绿色和平组织的研究分析了该地区磷虾渔船的活动，发现它们越来越多地在“企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼饲养场附近”作业。报告还重点介绍了渔船搁浅、溢油和事故等事件，对南极生态系统构成了严重威胁。

paragraphs.sourceText: The report, published on Tuesday, comes amid growing concern about the impact of fishing and climate change on the Antarctic. A global campaign has been launched to create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect the seas in the region and Greenpeace is calling for an immediate halt to fishing in areas being considered for sanctuary status.
paragraphs.translationZh: 该报告于周二发布，正值人们越来越担心渔业和气候变化对南极的影响。一项全球运动已经发起，旨在建立一个海洋保护区网络，以保护该地区的海洋，绿色和平组织呼吁立即停止在考虑设立保护区的地区进行捕捞。

paragraphs.sourceText: Frida Bengtsson from Greenpeace's Protect the Antarctic campaign said: " If the krill industry wants to show it's a responsible player, then it should be voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary, and should instead be backing the protection of these huge tracts of the Antarctic."
paragraphs.translationZh: 绿色和平组织保护南极运动的弗里达·本特森表示：“如果磷虾行业想要表明自己是一个负责任的参与者，那么它应该自愿离开任何被提议作为海洋保护区的地区，而应该支持对南极洲这些大片地区的保护。”

paragraphs.sourceText: A global campaign has been launched to tum a huge tract of Antarctic seas into ocean sanctuaries, protecting wildlife and banning not just krill fishing, but all fishing. One was created in the Ross Sea in 2016, another reserve is being proposed in a vast area of the Weddell Sea, and a third sanctuary is under consideration in the area west of the Antarctic Peninsula-a key krill fishing area.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一项全球运动已经发起，旨在将南极大片海域变成海洋保护区，保护野生动物，并禁止磷虾捕捞和所有捕捞活动。其中一个保护区于 2016 年在罗斯海建立，另一个保护区正在威德尔海的广阔区域内拟建，第三个保护区正在考虑在南极半岛以西的地区（主要磷虾捕捞区）建立。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Commission for the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources ( CCAMLR) manages the seas around Antarctica. It will decide on the Weddell Sea sanctuary proposal at a conference in Australia in October, although a decision on the peninsula sanctuary is not expected until later.
paragraphs.translationZh: 南极海洋生物资源保护委员会（CCAMLR）负责管理南极洲周围的海域。它将在 10 月份在澳大利亚举行的一次会议上就威德尔海保护区提案做出决定，不过预计要到晚些时候才会对半岛保护区做出决定。

paragraphs.sourceText: Keith Reid, a science manager at CCAMLR, said that the organisation sought " a balance between protection, conservation and sustainable fishing in the Southern Ocean." He said although more fishing was taking place nearer penguin colonies it was often happening later in the season when these colonies were empty.
paragraphs.translationZh: CCAMLR 的科学经理基思·里德 (Keith Reid) 表示，该组织寻求“南大洋保护、养护和可持续捕捞之间的平衡”。他说，尽管在靠近企鹅栖息地的地方进行了更多的捕鱼活动，但通常是在季节后期，当这些栖息地空无一人时才进行捕鱼。

paragraphs.sourceText: " The creation of a system of marine protected areas is a key part of ongoing scientific and policy discussions in CCAMLR," he added. " Our long-term operation in the region depends on a healthy and thriving Antarctic marine ecosystem, which is why we have always had an open dialogue with the environmental non-governmental organisations. We strongly intend to continue this dialogue, including talks with Greenpeace, to discuss improvements based on the latest scientific data. We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas, but we hope to contribute positively with our knowledge and experience."
paragraphs.translationZh: “建立海洋保护区系统是 CCAMLR 正在进行的科学和政策讨论的关键部分，”他补充道。 “我们在该地区的长期运营取决于健康和繁荣的南极海洋生态系统，这就是为什么我们一直与环境非政府组织进行公开对话。我们强烈打算继续这种对话，包括与绿色和平组织的会谈，讨论基于最新科学数据的改进措施。我们不是建立海洋保护区的决定者，但我们希望用我们的知识和经验做出积极贡献。”
